fixes.what: Replace `border-bottom: 2px solid var(--red)` with `text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--red); text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 6px;`
fixes.why: When inline links like 'Every tradition, in its own words' wrap onto two lines on mobile, `border-bottom` draws two stacked horizontal rules directly under each line, looking broken.

fixes.what: Change SVG path in HTML from curved `M4 12 C 90 12...` to a straight kashida stroke `M4 12 H316` or refine the curve into a true calligraphic nib taper.
fixes.why: The current S-curve looks like a generic squiggle rather than an authentic Persian typographic kashida extension.
In mid-scroll states (like the founder quote), the kashida line is barely a dot when the text is already fully read; it needs to finish drawing much earlier in the viewport.

fixes.what: Adjust `--edge-trunk: 44px` and `--gutter: 56px` on mobile, or soften the mask gradient `linear-gradient(to right, rgba(0,0,0,.75) 20%, transparent 90%)`
fixes.why: On 390px screens, the left trunk still creates a heavy visual weight on the left margin that makes centered elements (like the celebrations cards and form inputs) feel pushed right.

fixes.what: Remove `margin-top: clamp(24px,5vh,56px)` or reduce to `0`, and increase `.inquire` bottom padding slightly
fixes.why: The abrupt white-space gap before the `.ground` top gradient mask makes the roots feel pasted-on rather than organically emerging from the parchment.
